texts.preamble: R.Velusamy vs The Secretary To The Government Of Tamil ... on 10 July, 2019 Author: S.M.Subramaniam Bench: S.M.Subramaniam 1 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 10.07.2019 Coram: The Honourable Mr.Justice S.M.Subramaniam W.P.(MD)No.17855 of 2015 and M.P.(MD)Nos.2 to 4 of 2015 and W.M.P.(MD)No.14975 of 2016 1.R.Velusamy 2.K.Ganesan 3.G.Nirmala 4.K.Balasubramanian 5.N.Nirmala 6.A.Panneerselvam 7.A.Tamilselvan 8.A.Jaya Chandran 9.S.Ramani 10.P.Ravindran ... Petitioners -Vs- 1.The Secretary to the Government of Tamil Nadu, Health and Family Welfare Department, Fort St. George, Chennai-9. 2.The Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, D.M.S.Compound, Teynampet, Chennai-6. http://www.judis.nic.in 2 3.The Commissioner of Food Safety, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drugs R.Velusamy vs The Secretary To The Government Of Tamil ... on 10 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41839757/ 1 Administration Department, D.M.S.Compound, Teynampet, Chennai-6. ...Respondents Prayer: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constituti of India, praying for the issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, directin the respondents 2 and 3 to deploy the Health Inspector Grade-I working in the scale of pay of Rs.9300-34800+GP 4200 to the post of Food Safety Officer as per guidelines issued by the first respondent in Letter No.28594/AB2/2013-3, dated 25.11.2013 forthwith. For Petitioners : Mr.M.Saravana Kumar Order The relief sought for in the present Writ Petition is for a direction to direct the respondents 2 and 3 to deploy the Health Inspector Grade-I, working in the scale of pay of Rs.9300-34800+GP 4200 to the post of Food Safety Officer, as per guidelines issued by the first respondent in proceeding dated 25.11.2013.
texts.facts: Order The relief sought for in the present Writ Petition is for a direction to direct the respondents 2 and 3 to deploy the Health Inspector Grade-I, working in the scale of pay of Rs.9300-34800+GP 4200 to the post of Food Safety Officer, as per guidelines issued by the first respondent in proceeding dated 25.11.2013. separate Commissionaire was constituted under the head of Commissioner of Food Safety. The writ petitioner is the regular employee of the department of Public Health Preventive and Medicine and therefore, he cannot seek any deputation to another department, namely, Commissionaire of Food Safety, which is governed by the Commissioner of Food Safety.
texts.arguments: 2.Pursuant to the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act'), Under Section 36 of the Act, the Commissioner of Food Safety shall appoint Food Safety Officers. Section 37 of the Act reads as under:- 37.Food Safety Officer.-(1) The Commissioner of Food Safety shall, by notification, appoint such persons as he thinks fit, having the qualifications prescribed by the Central Government, as Food Safety Officers for such local areas as he may assign to them for the purpose of performing functions under this Act and the rules and regulations made thereunder. (2)The State Government may authorise any officer of the State Government having the qualifications prescribed under Sub-Section (1) to perform the functions of a Food Safety Officer within a specified jurisdiction. 3.As per the said provision, the Commissioner of Food Safety shall by notification appoint such persons as he thinks fit, having the qualifications prescribed by the Central Government, as http://www.judis.nic.in Food Safety Officers.
